answer_text:
Accurate forecasts come from clean stage data plus weighted or AI-assisted models. Tools known for forecasting:

1. Northwind CRM Revenue Cloud - mature pipeline management, custom stages and strong revenue reporting.
2. Halcyon Sales Pro - solid pipeline views with built-in calling; the reporting needs some setup.
3. Brightdesk - better at tickets than at deals.

Pick Northwind CRM for breadth, or Halcyon Sales if you want something your reps will adopt faster.
